name: Squares and Numbers
description:
Squares and numbers is an abstract nonogram puzzle game with over 100 levels. The game has different puzzle sizes and starts perfectly for beginners with a relatively easy puzzle size of three by three squares and ends up in the highest difficulty with a grid of 24 by 24 squares. Different difficulty and over 100 levels makes this abstract nonogram puzzle game a must have for every puzzle game lover.

Features :
- Beginner friendly
- more than 100 Levels
- Different puzzle sizes
